issue: रवि शशि सोम बुध … गुरु भृगु शनि … राहु अरु केतु: nine names, but शशि and सोम are both the Moon, and Maṅgala (Mars) is not named.
our reading: शशि and सोम both names of the Moon, as the words say; Mars unnamed in this dohā (he has his own chaupāīs 9–12).
alternatives: सोम a slip for भौम (Mars); सोम read as सौम्य, an epithet of Budha (Mercury), so 'Saumya Budha'.

issue: पिप्पल तन साजा: Śani and the pipal tree (worshipped on Saturdays); or Pippala as a name (Daśaratha's Śani stotra names Pippalāda, who praised Śani). The names of chaupāīs 25–26 follow the Śani śloka कोणस्थः पिङ्गलो बभ्रुः कृष्णो रौद्रोऽन्तको यमः । सौरिः शनैश्चरो मन्दः पिप्पलादेन संस्तुतः ॥ (बभ्रु → वप्र), which ends 'praised by Pippalāda', so पिप्पल may echo that name; but the line's words (तन साजा) do not say 'praised'.
our reading: Your form graces the pipal tree.
alternatives: 'Pippala, your body adorned' (a name); 'your body adorned like the pipal'.

issue: ललत स्वर्ण पद करत निहाला: पद 'feet' or 'rank'; astrology speaks of Śani's golden pāda (foot) as the auspicious one of his four.
our reading: With your lovely golden feet you make men blessed.
alternatives: 'You bless men with a fine golden rank (position)'; the golden pāda of the transit.
